messages:
maria: sec-bot flagged a secret in CI artifact cache. artifact: s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/builds/2026/03/18/3779/deploy.log
sec-bot: [AUTOMATED] detection_id=DET-2026-78 severity=high pattern=plaintext_token snippet:
```
... DEPLOY STEP: export SERVICE_DEPLOY_TOKEN=svc_tok_7fTqJx9b
... calling https://internal.api.redwood/
```
chris: copying. can you paste the exact token id? we need to revoke immediately
maria: token is svc_tok_7fTqJx9b. i revoked the token in internal token service and disabled the ci job: `ci/deploy-master` hold for now :white_check_mark:
alex: good. i'll rotate credentials for the service and push dummy creds. @devops_lead can you purge the artifact from s3 and remove any cached copies from our artifact cache, also check if any downloads after the artifact was created
devops_lead: purging now: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/builds/2026/03/18/3779/deploy.log` then running invalidation on the artifact CDN. checking access logs...
sec-bot: S3 access logs show only internal CI role (ci-runner-role) downloaded the artifact, no external IPs. cloudtrail lookup shows only CreateObject events by CI account.
taylor: we should hunt git history for the secret to see if it was committed in any branch. run: `git rev-list --all | xargs -n1 git grep -F "svc_tok_7fTqJx9b"` and `trufflehog --json .`
sre_oncall: did that, grep found it in commit 3a7f2b4 on branch feature/auto-deploy. `git show 3a7f2b4:ci/scripts/deploy.sh` shows `export SERVICE_DEPLOY_TOKEN=svc_tok_7fTqJx9b`
maria: looks like someone added quick local token to script for testing and it got merged. no sign of push to mirrors. i'm opening SEC-345 (INC-2026-57) to track.
alex: we need to rewrite history to remove token, but coordinate with the teams. options: `git filter-repo --path ci/scripts/deploy.sh --replace-text replacements.txt` or `bfg`. i'm in favor of filter-repo since it's precise.
chris: agree. after history rewrite, we'll coordinate forced updates with consumers and org owners. also add automated pre-merge check to block `svc_tok_` patterns and ensure CI secrets come from parameter store + KMS.
devops_lead: plan: 1) purge artifact (done) 2) revoke token (done) 3) rotate service creds (in progress) 4) run repo-history scrub and force-push 5) run org-wide secret-scan (trufflehog + rg) 6) add pre-commit/githook + repo linter 7) update CI to use SSM/KMS for secrets
maria: one more: check our audit logs and RBAC: who had ability to create tokens? we should restrict token creation to ops role. filing SEC-346 to tighten IAM policy.
sec-bot: quick notes: automated mitigation checklist completed: artifact_purged=true token_revoked=true scan_commenced=true
chris: follow-ups: - add KMS-encrypted parameter store usage docs to devex - add CI log masking for env vars - add 7-day audit retention for CI artifact buckets - schedule org-wide trufflehog weekly
taylor: i'll own the postmortem and the runbook update. expected ETA for postmortem draft: 48hrs. will include timelines, root cause (dev token in merged script), and remediation verification steps.
alex: also add detection rule to sec-bot for plaintext-looking tokens in CI artifacts and enable webhook alert to #incidents. consider adding a lightweight content-check step in the artifact pipeline.
maria: thanks everyone. no customer impact identified. moving to postmortem tracking SEC-345 and closing active response channel :white_check_mark:
